reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner-operator with calm, grounded tone and no sales CTA, though it briefly uses first-person singular ('I') instead of Bareni's standard public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: The core point and reasoning are immediately clear, logically sequenced, and free from technical jargon or unnecessary padding.
reasons.actionability: Provides an immediate, low-effort diagnostic exercise (reviewing 5–10 recordings side-by-side) before advising any pilot or technology investment.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to evidence boundaries without inventing customers, metrics, or unverified platform capabilities.
